notes: Values are a local frozen record of evidence inspected on the retrieval date.
Upstream revision URLs are preferred where available; mutable web pages are dated and their decision-relevant rows are transcribed below.
Open ASR values below use the source column explicitly named 'avg' at revision a0c08d3ac1ef99ea7148666061839b853cbfa89a.
Scores from different benchmarks or protocols are never compared numerically.
A public benchmark link explains the live benchmark; a pinned revision identifies the exact source state used for a recorded value.
Selection evidence and executable artifact locks are separate: an authoritative run requires both.

ranked_candidate_requirements: The public result predates the evidence cutoff.
The benchmark task and metric are relevant to the EduMind component.
Every decision-relevant row in the declared comparison set is frozen here or in a pinned source.
The candidate passes the component's parameter tier, license, and required-capability filters.
The candidate is the best eligible row in that frozen comparison set.
unresolved_challenger_requirements: An exact model revision and a public task-specific result are available before the evidence cutoff.
The candidate passes the same parameter tier, license, and required-capability filters.
A protocol mismatch prevents a defensible numerical comparison with the ranked candidate.

selection_policy.benchmark_control_rule: A control is retained to measure improvement over EduMind's current or canonical baseline. It does not need to win the public-evidence screen.
selection_policy.preliminary_screening_rule: When no task-specific public benchmark compares eligible current compact models under one protocol, relevant but non-authoritative evidence may create a small local shortlist. These rows are not public benchmark winners; EduMind's grounded local benchmark makes the selection.
selection_policy.license_rule: An included model must be self-hostable and its published terms must permit the intended EduMind use without requiring a paid hosted service. Non-commercial-only models are excluded. License is an eligibility gate, not a quality score.
selection_policy.decision_rule: A competing model checkpoint is included only as a ranked candidate, unresolved challenger, preliminary screening candidate, or benchmark control under the rules above. Parameter bands are recorded in size_tier; selection_role records the machine-readable role; score_status and reason explain the evidence and decision. Final promotion always depends on EduMind's own benchmark.
selection_policy.size_tier_rule: size_tier contains only a declared parameter band or N/A. Controls and non-model products use N/A; experimental roles never appear in this field.
selection_policy.diagnostic_evaluator_rule: An evaluator may be included when it implements a required automated diagnostic and has relevant public validation evidence. It is not a competing model candidate, is not promotable as the authoritative judge, and does not replace human evaluation.
selection_policy.vector_database_rule: A vector-database product may be included when it is a self-hosted network server, represents a distinct first-round architectural design point, has an implementable common benchmark interface, and has a pinned non-prerelease server profile. Official sources establish capability; real local conformance and benchmark results decide eligibility and promotion. The four model-selection paths do not apply.
selection_policy.evidence_ledger_scope: selection_evidence.csv contains externally sourced model checkpoints and vector-database products only. Internally defined chunking, retrieval, video-keyframe, and normalization strategies are documented experiment hypotheses, not evidence-ledger rows. The Docling control configuration is snapshotted here but is not a CSV model-selection row. Modality-level image, PDF, DOCX, routing, and normalization candidate registries remain authoritative in their experiment directories.
selection_policy.evidence_source_state_rule: CSV quality_source_state and task_evidence_state values contain an immutable commit or digest when one exists; otherwise they contain a dated snapshot or operational-version note. These are selection-audit fields, while executable artifact locks remain mandatory for authoritative runs.

candidate_universes.embedding: Tier winners come from the frozen comparison tables recorded below; candidates with current MTEB or RTEB evidence on a non-comparable protocol are included as unresolved challengers.
candidate_universes.reranker: All 23 rows in the May 2026 common MTEB English-v2 top-100 reranking table. Ranked candidates and the control use this one protocol.
candidate_universes.document_vlm: This is an end-to-end extraction-profile screen, not a ranking of standalone OCR engines, native PDF libraries, or DOCX parsers. The numerical screen contains full-document parsers at or below 1.5B parameters in the pinned OmniDocBench v1.6 table. PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 has the highest integrated score in that size-filtered table and is the only inspected row whose license, exact weights, self-hosted execution, and local inference path were all verified. It is included as the single evidence-backed visual-fallback candidate, not claimed as the winner of a multi-candidate eligible comparison. MinerU2.5-Pro and GLM-OCR remain numerical context only.
candidate_universes.generation: Three directly justified compact profiles are shortlisted at approximately 1B, 3B, and 5B. The nine recorded Artificial Analysis rows are the alternatives actually reviewed, not an exhaustive catalogue. MiniCPM5-1B is run in reasoning mode to test whether explicit deliberation improves grounded QA and citations enough to justify its measured runtime cost; G9v3-3B is the strongest scored row in the reviewed <=4B table; Qwen3.5-4B is the upper compact quality ceiling from its direct page. ALCE, FaithJudge, ChatRAG-Bench, and FACTS Grounding do not report all three under one protocol, so the local grounded-RAG benchmark makes the final selection.
candidate_universes.asr: Rows reviewed from the pinned Open ASR English short-form result file, grouped by parameter tier and filtered for a verified timestamp path. Short-form results only create the shortlist; every included model plus Whisper must pass EduMind's local long-form screen before promotion.
candidate_universes.vector_database: First round contains Chroma as the current server baseline, Qdrant and Weaviate as purpose-built vector servers, and PostgreSQL plus pgvector as the relational design point. Milvus and OpenSearch are recorded as deferred scope decisions; FAISS and Pinecone fail the server/self-hosting boundary.

Full Ollama manifest digest, quantization, inference mode, context length, and sampling settings for every executed generation profile in data/benchmarks/models/ollama.json.
Immutable repo@sha256 Docker image digest and matching client version for every vector server in data/benchmarks/models/vectordb.json.
RapidOCR package version plus model-file checksums for the Docling control profile.

omnidoc_v1_6.numerical_screen_boundary: specialized full-document parser rows in the pinned OmniDocBench v1.6 table with <=1.5B parameters; this numerical boundary makes no candidate-eligibility claim
omnidoc_v1_6.candidate_eligibility_requirements: open weights; self-hosted execution; published terms permit the intended EduMind use; exact weights are pinned; local inference path is reviewed
omnidoc_v1_6.boundary_rationale: The numerical screen asks whether a compact visual fallback improves difficult documents without immediately expanding to larger parsers that test the same architecture at higher operational cost. docling_control_profile.role: required unified-parser control with targeted formula-VLM enrichment and no full-page VLM
docling_control_profile.freeze_status: configuration-frozen; RapidOCR package and model-file revisions must be pinned in the runnable registry before authoritative execution
docling_control_profile.rationale: The profile preserves native PDF text where usable, OCRs image/non-text regions, prioritizes table structure, and uses CodeFormulaVlmModel for targeted formula enrichment while full-page VLM parsing remains disabled. Its settings are frozen rather than assumed optimal.

benchmark_controls.purpose: Controls measure improvement over current or canonical baselines and are not public-leaderboard winners.

open_asr.aggregate_note: The pinned avg column includes the cleaned/chunked Earnings22 result and the other default English short-form WER columns shown in the source.
open_asr.track_scope: The recorded numeric comparison is English short-form only. The Open ASR project has a separate long-form track; short- and long-form scores are not merged.
open_asr.long_form_promotion_rule: Every included short-form tier representative plus the Whisper control must be evaluated on EduMind's frozen long-form educational subset. No model is promoted from the short-form table alone.

ettin_reranker.evidence_type: author-run public common-protocol comparison; not an independent official leaderboard
ettin_reranker.protocol: MTEB(eng,v2) Retrieval; top-100 reranked; mean NDCG@10 over six embedder pairings
ettin_reranker.scope: Complete 23-model table covering Qwen, Mixedbread, Jina, GTE, Granite, BGE, ZeroEntropy, MiniLM, and Ettin model families.
ettin_reranker.public_result_checkpoint_revision_status: The article does not identify the exact checkpoint commits used for its public scores. Public values are attributed to the pinned article; EduMind local results are attributed to the separately pinned runnable revisions.

artificial_analysis_compact_screen.status: preliminary evidence-gap screen only; the nine rows are alternatives actually reviewed, not the complete Artificial Analysis catalogue and not a global tier ranking; scores are treated as estimates where the model page says independent evaluation is forthcoming; the 4.7B Qwen row uses its direct model page because Artificial Analysis places models above 4B outside Tiny
artificial_analysis_compact_screen.screen_scope: Three directly justified profiles near 1B, 3B, and 5B. MiniCPM5-1B reasoning is the compact point and tests whether deliberation improves grounded RAG enough to justify its runtime cost; G9v3-3B reasoning is the strongest scored row in the reviewed <=4B table; Qwen3.5-4B reasoning is the upper compact quality ceiling. The rows support shortlist plausibility only.
artificial_analysis_compact_screen.inference_mode_policy: Each generator is executed only in the recorded mode. MiniCPM5-1B reasoning and non-reasoning both score 12 in the reviewed table; EduMind deliberately keeps only reasoning mode and measures its quality, token, and latency effects locally. G9v3-3B and Qwen3.5-4B retain the reasoning modes attached to their recorded public values. Modes are never averaged, silently changed, or allowed to inherit another mode's score.
